Maya: short postmortem follow-up  we need a focused test sweep and detector tuning for the KV-eviction pattern. items: regression sweep, incident-driven promptset, a short-run staging burst, and a small blast-radius chaos test. owners below.
Chris: i'll take the regression sweep + CI work. plan: PR-level quick checks (subset) and a daily full-sweep job. ETA 2025-04-03. i'll add severity labels to tests so gating is configurable.
Asha: i'll own the promptset and evals. i'll extract ~22 edge traces (truncated-prefix, kv-miss cascade, transient OOM-ish) and tag with severity + root-cause. ETA 2025-04-09. will include tiny repro scripts.
Vik: i'll spin up the staging burst job and run a scoped chaos test. proposal: one-weekly spike in staging and a single controlled cross-region handoff drill with canary fallback only. need runbook & rollback snippets. ETA infra-as-code 2025-04-11.
Chris: sample GH action for the PR subset: ```yaml
name: kv-evict-pr-checks
on: pull_request
jobs:
  quick-regress:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./ci/kv_regress.sh --subset quick
```
Maya: good. gating policy: start advisory; after coverage >= 75% of incident cases we flip high/critical to block releases. record coverage metric in job artifacts.
Asha: for eval metrics i'll push p95/p99, token-loss fraction, and a simple overlap score. artifacts go to gs://evals/kv-evict and a small dashboard.
Chris: detector idea: eviction_rate > 0.05 AND p95 > 1.8x baseline => append to pattern digest. i'll prototype a lightweight detector PR and wire digest to #eng-sre.
Vik: chaos checklist (short): preflight health, canary fallback map, abort cmd, contact list, metric thresholds. will draft and push as PR to infra/runbooks.
Maya: also add automated work item: when digest shows >=3 similar incidents in 14 days create a pattern-watch ticket and ping owners. Asha/Chris/Vik should be listed as default triage owners.
AlertBot: ticket INF-9510 created: "KV eviction test sweep" -> Chris, due 2025-04-03.
AlertBot: ticket INF-9511 created: "KV eviction promptset & evals" -> Asha, due 2025-04-09.
AlertBot: ticket INF-9512 created: "Staging burst + scoped chaos" -> Vik, due 2025-04-11.
Chris: small follow-up: standardize job names to `releases/kv_eviction/{pr,nightly}` so history aggregates.
Asha: i'll include small golden-response asserts for the highest-severity prompts so we catch silent quality regressions during perf incidents.
Vik: for blast radius we do canary-only in month one; if stable we can expand. will include explicit abort sequence in runbook.
Maya: scheduling a 20m sync on 2025-03-30 10:00 UTC to review PR stubs and the promptset. invite to owners. please update tickets with blockers. :thumbsup:
